Message from a parent
---------------------

My daughter is 9 and was diagnosed autistic last year. She's academically ahead of her
year group — reading well above age, very strong at maths. No developmental delay, no
seizures, nothing else medical. No family history that I know of.

I've read that genetic testing is recommended for autism. I asked the paediatrician and
she said it "probably wouldn't be offered" but didn't really explain why. That felt like a
brush-off.

Should I be pushing for this? We're in England.
